source: Matias et al. (2021), The Upworthy Research Archive
verified_sections: Methods, editorial decisions to conclude experiments
Technical Validation, follow-up tests and shared content
supported_facts: Editors monitored accumulated outcomes before deciding when to stop tests.
Follow-up tests could be recorded under different test IDs while sharing content.
methodological_implications: Ordinary fixed-horizon p-values are not proven calibrated under that monitoring; multiplicity adjustment alone cannot supply missing validity.
Resampling IDs independently does not account for dependence among related tests. Actual impact is unquantified; neither an inflated interval nor a sign reversal is asserted.
scope: Primary facts verified directly. Earlier allocation-risk exclusion does not address either issue.
